author: Microsoft
description:
Discover how a Nairobi startup is helping small business owners turn simple mobile‑money statements into powerful insights. Auni - an AI app built by Fastagger and powered by Microsoft tools - can even run on older 4GB smartphones and works offline, making data analysis accessible to thousands of micro‑enterprises across Kenya. From beard‑care brands to barbershops, business owners are using Auni to understand customers, track revenue, and grow with confidence.
